mapper.insert: insert into user_agent_message (message_id, session_id, task_id, role, content, content_type, token_count, seq_no, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{tokenCount}, #{seqNo}, now())

insert ignore into user_agent_message (message_id, session_id, task_id, role, content, content_type, token_count, seq_no, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{tokenCount}, #{seqNo}, now())
mapper.select: select * from user_agent_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by seq_no asc
select coalesce(max(seq_no), 0) + 1 from user_agent_message where session_id = #{sessionId}
